question: Can a source-blind sparse high-order counterhypothesis challenge reduce confident errors from premature degree3/4 conclusions without sacrificing useful correct predictions, on fresh query-blind causal worlds under identical acquired information, compared with the unchanged WSP145 candidate, depth-only abstention and independently fitted controls?
hypothesis: A shallow exact-fit (depth3/4) might be an alias for a causal law containing a rare depth5 conjunction. Before claiming confident predictions, test whether any exact-fit depth5 alternative with <=4 terms can disagree on that query. Abstain selectively on such structural conflicts. Never use hidden truth or future question coordinates.

fresh_public_source.namespace: WSP146|SOURCE| (independent from all WSP135-WSP145 scored worlds)
fresh_public_source.source_private: Law generator, hidden roles, true effect outcomes and post-seal scoring remain owner-only. Identical generic synthetic AND/XOR causal family as WSP145 with fresh SHA256 source namespace, not a novel physical causal source.

acquisition.random: EXACT WSP145 source-blind random20+12 keyed by new public law_id
acquisition.adaptive: EXACT WSP145 frozen outcome-adaptive20+12 algorithm, unmodified, new public law IDs only
acquisition.all_arms: 20 common original WSP135 ordered inputs, then 12 policy-specific actual-effect observations. 32 per arm/world; no extra acquisition for confidence method.
acquisition.score_locations: Only after all three policies have sealed 64 outputs for all models, owner picks 8 shared never-paid x ranked by SHA256('WSP146|HELD|public_law_id|x') from 3-arm never-paid intersection. Hidden labels held privately; score world as independent unit. Action union max56, at least 8 common unseen.

candidate.name: shallow_hypothesis_challenge
candidate.base: EXACT unchanged WSP143 four-term source-blind hierarchical fit and readout on each policy's own 32 observed effects.
candidate.behavior: For each world and every x in 0..63, keep original prediction if no shallow structural challenge. If base prediction is None or base state's fitted depth is <=2 or exactly5, return it unchanged. Only when base fitted level is 3 or4 AND prediction is confident, test high-order competing explanations as follows; output None (abstain) if any candidate provably disagrees, else original prediction.
candidate.challenge: For each of the six possible six-factor degree5 conjunction masks m=(31,47,55,59,61,62), let target be observed XOR effect bits, and residual target XOR mask's 32-bit activation signature. Run unchanged WSP143 exact _solve only over the 57 features of degree<=4 to find a zero-to-three-term explanation of the residual. If any returned minimum-ranked solution uses <=3 terms, yields an exact-fit four-or-fewer-term explanation including m, and predicts a different output at x than the base prediction, with conflict there, abstain on x. If solver overflows >10000 equally ranked fits, conservatively abstain on all x for that mask when an alternative cannot be enumerated. Never silently select one of conflicting programs. Do not consult future x locations: produce complete 64-vector before withheld selection.
candidate.source_blind_inputs: Only charged own rows and generic public feature masks. No source module, law family, ground truth, post-seal questions, scoring, or other arms.

comparison_ablations.unchanged_baseline: Exactly original WSP145 H.predict, with same rows and same actions.
comparison_ablations.depth_only: Simple predeclared control abstains on every non-None prediction if fitted depth is3 or4; otherwise unchanged.
comparison_ablations.random_equal_coverage: After all full64 prediction vectors sealed, source-private evaluator computes descriptive count-matched deterministic random abstention over the 8 held x for each policy/world using 'WSP146|RANDOMABSTAIN|law_id|x' (diagnostic only, explicitly label-aware count matching; not causal selection or primary mechanism).
comparison_ablations.flat_symbolic: Independent WSP143 same-information flat exact symbolic predictions must tie original hierarchical baseline; any structural challenge must be numerically and symbolically reproducible.
comparison_ablations.conventional: Unchanged fully fitted WSP135 CART, original WSP142 direct3 and WSP135 latent, source-blind, fitted to identical 32 per-arm effects; no-update control.

frozen_metrics.primary_family: FIVE: 32 independent worlds x8 shared post-seal held x =256 paired predictions per arm. World-level win/loss/tie and uncertainty reported (don't treat 256 within-world answers as independent).
frozen_metrics.source_receipts: 6144 charged events; 0 protected original events; 32 per policy per world
frozen_metrics.whole_process_cost: Measure separate candidate challenge CPU wall peak memory and whole 3-arm source+fit+readout. Must not assert efficiency advantage absent matched workload. Candidate challenge overhead >=0, target <=3x baseline fit/readout CPU in identical study; exceeding this is development NO-GO.

qualification.phase1: Sole-file prereg at exact parent. Source-first-use forbidden before independent source-free code/negative tests.
qualification.phase2: Source-blind challenge module + unit tests on fabricated mechanical rows only. Linux+Windows verify no source effects charged; preserve WSP145 frozen files exactly.
qualification.phase3: Fresh source-safe custodian, owner-held prediction sealing, three-arm new public causal trial with original frozen controls. Linux+Windows authentic first result; archive original irrespective of negative.
qualification.phase4: Source-pin G29 derived-only atlas, full final exact SHA inherited WSP135-137,139,141-146 and original complete root regression on Linux+Windows, independent G29 acceptance.
qualification.boundary: Draft-only, no merge, original protected first-use, native model change, controller/scheduler/runner, paid APIs, acceptance promotion or deployment.
